title: Adult Normative Data for the Glottal Enterprices Aeroview System
summary: The purpose of this study is to collect reference data (a set of comparative values) for the Aeroview system from Glottal Enterprises for the German language. This is one of only two devices worldwide used to measure airflow during speech. To date, such comparative values have only been available for English-speaking regions. These were collected using the other device (the PAS system from Pentax Medical). The aim of the study is to determine normal values and ranges of variation based on the results, particularly for German-speaking regions. The non-invasive measuring device is intended for use in future studies involving patients with voice problems to improve the accuracy of diagnosis.
conditions: None—only healthy participants are included in the study

interventions.name: Two examination appointments for healthy adults, taking into account age and gender differences, each lasting approximately 10 minutes. There is a break of about 14 days between the two appointments.
